summary: Frontend-only verification completed for Back to Circuit overview behavior across Legacy, Records, and Victories on public URL. Requested flows passed on desktop/mobile, including scroll preservation, chapter marker routing, overview resume behavior, and stale overview close on hash/menu navigation.
action_items: No blocking fixes required for the requested bug scope.

Optional test-maintenance: when asserting racing-line progress, use computed stroke-dasharray (or visual assertions) instead of pathLength attribute, which remains normalized to 1 in Framer Motion SVG output.
critical_code_review_comments: Overview state handling is correctly decoupled from scroll position: Back to Circuit toggles overlay without rewinding scroll.
Hash/menu route changes correctly clear stale overview via shared state path in SpatialExperience + Nav go().
Marker interactions are accessible through click and keyboard with dedicated data-testid coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://lewis-victories.preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed Legacy/Records/Victories Back to Circuit preserves window.scrollY and shows approx 2%/38%/90% respectively. Glowing racing line progression verified via computed stroke-dasharray growth (~0.021, ~0.383, ~0.904). Marker current/different chapter routing passes. Wheel/touch/keyboard exits overview and resumes journey. Hash/menu navigation closes stale overview. Desktop/mobile checks show no overflow, blank viewport, or page error messages for tested flows.
rca of the issue: Root cause of original bug (rewind to circuit start) is resolved by overview-mode implementation that toggles isCircuitOverview/overviewRef and calls updateCamera(scrollYProgress.get()) without invoking scroll-to-start logic. Repro now shows identical scrollY before/after Back to Circuit and contextual coverage label retained at current chapter position.
